references.text: The heart is more deceitful than anything else, and it is incurable. Who can understand it?
The Lord says: Because this people draw near to me with their mouth and honor me with their lips, but their heart is far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment taught by men

But what comes out of the mouth proceeds from the heart, and that is what defiles a person. For from the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false witness, slander. These are what defile a person, but to eat with unwashed hands does not defile a person.
The good person brings forth good things from the good treasure of their heart, and the evil person brings forth evil things from their evil treasure. For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.
Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, with our hearts sprinkled clean from an evil conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.
